meta.name: lark-workflow-standup-report
meta.description: 日程待办摘要：编排 calendar +agenda 和 task +get-my-tasks，生成指定日期的日程与未完成任务摘要。适用于了解今天/明天/本周的安排。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动汇总日程与待办，生成每日工作摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要快速了解当日日程和未完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Automatically summarize calendar and tasks for daily standup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick daily summary of your schedule and pending tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会调用 lark-cli 读取指定日期的日程和未完成待办，汇总成一份摘要：日程表（含时间、组织者、状态）、待办清单，以及小结（会议数、待办数、时间冲突与空闲时段）。仅支持 user 身份。
howto.when: 当你问「今天有什么安排」「明天有什么会」「早报摘要」等，想了解今天、明天或本周的日程与待办时触发。需提前授权 calendar 和 task 权限。

say.note: 生成今天的日程与未完成待办摘要

say.text: 帮我看看明天有什么会和待办
say.note: 输出明日日程与未完成任务

howto.what_en: Claude reads your calendar and incomplete tasks for a given date via lark-cli, then outputs a dated summary: agenda table with time, organizer and RSVP status, a to-do list, and a wrap-up with counts, conflicts and free slots.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask e.g. "what's on today", "meetings tomorrow" or "standup report" — when you want today's, tomorrow's or this week's schedule and tasks. Needs user identity.

say_en.note: Summarizes today's events and open tasks

say_en.text: Show me tomorrow's meetings and to-dos
say_en.note: Outputs tomorrow's agenda and unfinished tasks

say_en.text: What's left on my calendar this week?
say_en.note: Summarizes this week's schedule and tasks
